Shraddha Dubey denies involvement in Shiva Sharma case, claims innocence

Shraddha Dubey, a model and accused in the Shiva Sharma murder case in Lucknow, has released a video denying her involvement and stating she will surrender if presented with evidence. Dubey, who has a Rs 25,000 reward on her head, claims Sharma's death was a suicide, not a murder, and expressed a desire to give a statement to the police. Shiva Sharma, a millionaire businessman, was found with 10 serious injuries, and Dubey remains at large six days after the incident.
